verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report describes building an internal app 'w/ auth, roles' with v0. First-party docs claim full-stack scaffolding and list integrations with backend services like Supabase, so auth scaffolding is plausible. However, no documentation explicitly describes sign-up/login generation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on auth scaffolding, explicit email sign-up/login support, social/OAuth provider support, and details of how auth integrates with Supabase or other providers.
